## Executive Signals
- Anthropic will price its offering on **Wednesday 18 November** and start trading **Thursday 19 November** on Nasdaq as **ANT**, with the order book reported at roughly six times the shares on offer and the total raise reaching up to about **$90.4 billion** including the $26 billion private placement (Section 6).
- Alibaba made flagship **Qwen4-Max** generally available on 16 November — a **2.4-trillion-parameter** mixture-of-experts model with a 1-million-token context and native image input, priced below Qwen3.8-Max (Section 1).
- The **United States and nine Pax Silica partners signed the San Francisco Declaration** on 15 November, agreeing a shared list of sensitive AI technologies and supply-chain protections (Section 6).
- The **"Stand With Jensen" campaign to reinstate Jensen Huang** at Nvidia passed **165,000 signatures**, Elon Musk among them, as the Financial Times reported Huang had discussed returning (Section 5).
- **LangChain raised a $300 million Series C led by CapitalG at a $3 billion valuation**, a bet on the agent-orchestration layer rather than the models (Section 6).

The Financial Times reported on 15 November that Huang had discussed returning with allies; the board has not responded on the record, and signature counts are self-reported. Sources: [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/16/nvidia-jensen-huang-return-tech.html) · [Malay Mail](https://www.malaymail.com/news/money/2026/11/15/petition-for-jensen-huangs-return-as-nvidia-ceo-draws-thousands-of-signatures-including-elon-musk/243376) · [explainx](https://www.explainx.ai/blog/jensen-huang-comeback-talk-allies-ft-november-2026).
- **Yann LeCun (2026-11-15):** Speaking at CoRL 2026, LeCun said LLMs already excel at math, code and proteins but argued that JEPA world models are the serious path to human-level AI, repeating his advice not to work on LLMs for that goal. These are his direct remarks. Sources: [explainx](https://www.explainx.ai/blog/yann-lecun-corl-2026-dont-work-on-llms-jepa-career-advice).
- **Elon Musk (2026-11-14–15):** Musk signed the reinstatement petition and posted that Nvidia's critical supply deals were built on Huang's personal handshakes, warning the company risks losing them. The warning is verified as his own statement; whether the deals depend on Huang is analyst opinion, not Nvidia disclosure. Source: [explainx](https://www.explainx.ai/blog/elon-musk-nvidia-handshake-supply-deals-claimed-vs-verified-2026).

The oversubscription figure comes from Reuters and Bloomberg sources, not Anthropic's newsroom. Sources: [TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262304476-anthropic-ipo-ant-price-above-78-orders-six-times-november-14-2026-tradingkey) · [Asia Times](https://asiatimes.com/2026/11/anthropic-ipo-the-age-of-miracles-priced-at-78-a-share/) · [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/10/anthropic-sets-price-range-of-70-to-78-in-upcoming-ipo.html) · [explainx](https://www.explainx.ai/blog/anthropic-ipo-six-times-oversubscribed-claimed-vs-verified-2026).
- **2026-11-15 — US and nine allies sign the San Francisco Declaration:** At the Pax Silica Founders Retreat, the United States and participants from Australia, India, Israel, Japan, South Korea, Qatar, Singapore, the UAE and the UK agreed a common definition of sensitive AI technologies and critical infrastructure and set up five working groups spanning policy, adoption, supply-chain cooperation, safe harbors and security. Sources: [US State Department](https://www.state.gov/releases/office-of-the-spokesman/2026/11/the-san-francisco-declaration-on-the-secure-foundations-of-enduring-prosperity/) · [FT](https://www.ft.com/content/3c2197fc-9618-4838-91e6-522ce1a96a22) · [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-15/us-allies-agree-to-guard-ai-supply-chains-from-china-ft-says).
- **2026-11-14 — LangChain raises $300 million at a $3 billion valuation:** The Series C, led by CapitalG with GIC, DFJ Growth, IVP and Sapphire Ventures, funds LangChain's agent development and management platform; the company says LangSmith now has about 7,000 customers, including Nvidia, Toyota and Salesforce. Reported terms. Sources: [AI Agent Store](https://aiagentstore.ai/ai-agent-news/this-week) · [WebProNews](https://www.webpronews.com/langchain-300-million-series-c-3-billion-valuation-langsmith/).

## Editorial Notes
- **Reported, not confirmed:** Anthropic's six-times oversubscription, $90.4 billion total raise and final pricing come from Reuters and Bloomberg sourcing and financial press; Anthropic's own roadshow terms and the 19 November listing are confirmed. The LangChain round is press-reported. The "Stand With Jensen" signature count and affiliations are self-reported, and Nvidia's board has not responded on the record.
- **Unverified claims:** Physicist Nathaniel Craig says GPT-6 Astra led a candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model, which experts have not judged settled; we exclude it as a settled result. The Qwen4-Max cost and guardrail figures are Alibaba's own.
- **Vendor claims:** Specifications, latency figures and evaluations in Sections 1–3 are the developers' or authors' own except where a named third party (e.g., GitDiscover) is cited; Haru-4B publishes no benchmarks.
- **Date caveats:** LangChain's round is dated 13 November by some outlets and 14 November by our primary aggregator, so it is shown as 14 November; sources place the Apple Health AI study launch on 15–16 November. Items widely recirculated in the 14–16 November roundups but originally dated earlier — Gemini Glasses pre-orders (12–13 Nov), Claude Code "Code Mode" (12 Nov), Cloudflare's open-sourced Kitesurf browser (12 Nov), Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing (12–13 Nov), and Google's LEAP Birkhoff-conjecture formalization (13 Nov) — fall before START_UTC and are excluded.
- **Project metrics:** GitHub star totals and 24-hour deltas come from GitDiscover read 2026-11-16 UTC and move quickly; repositories marked "See repo" have no single verified top-level license.
- **Recovery items:** None. No consequential acquisition, merger, funding round, model release or regulatory decision from 2026-11-07–14 was found absent from the two most recent briefings; every item above was first announced or materially updated inside the primary window 2026-11-14T06:42:51Z–2026-11-16T06:42:51Z.
